# Test fonts

These fonts are copied from Skia's test resources (`skia/resources/fonts` at the pinned m142 checkout — originally so
the same files could be parsed by both the Go port and the since-removed C reference library):

- `Roboto-Regular.ttf` — Roboto (Apache License 2.0, Google). A glyf/TrueType font with OS/2 v4.
- `DejaVuSans.subset.ttf` — subset of DejaVu Sans (DejaVu Fonts License, a free license derived from Bitstream Vera).
  Small glyf font with a sparse cmap.
- `test.ttc` — Skia-authored TrueType collection (BSD-3-Clause, part of the Skia tree) with two faces, used to exercise
  collection-index handling.
- `colr.ttf` — Skia-authored COLRv0/CPAL test font (BSD-3-Clause): U+1F600 maps to a five-layer color glyph (two palette
  layers plus three foreground-color layers).
- `sbix.ttf` — Skia-authored sbix test font (BSD-3-Clause): U+1F600 with PNG strikes at 16/64/128 ppem.
- `cbdt.ttf` — Skia-authored CBDT/CBLC test font (BSD-3-Clause): U+1F600 with PNG strikes at 16/64/128 ppem.
- `test_glyphs-glyf_colr_1.ttf` — "COLRv1 Static Test Glyphs" (2024-01-18 build), the COLRv1 conformance test font
  generated by [googlefonts/color-fonts](https://github.com/googlefonts/color-fonts) (Apache License 2.0), copied from
  Skia's test resources at the pinned m142 checkout (`resources/fonts`; Skia's `gm/colrv1.cpp` documents the
  codepoint→test-case groups, e.g. U+F0100… gradients, U+F0A00… composite modes, U+F1100… paint-graph cycles).

They are test inputs only and are not part of the shipped library.
